method: Verified the exact current manifest digest and all 96 member SHA-256 digests; checked embedded browser, benchmark, HTTP and package source identities against this manifest.
Read current routing models/search/session/planning/replay, snapshot/timezone/storage, server request conversion/reader/API, internal updater/admin and demo/reset boundaries.

Reran tests/test_routing.py, tests/test_web.py, tests/test_sqlite.py, tests/test_client.py and tests/test_boundaries.py: 359 passed with one upstream Starlette deprecation warning. These include independent exhaustive routing oracles, constraint/ranking/limit cases, HTTP behavior, DST, whole-batch imports, guarded reset and separate-process WAL snapshots.
Reran Ruff lint and format checks on 29 reviewed Python files and Git whitespace checks; all passed.
Independently compared all 42 listed package files against the rebuilt wheel and verified wheel SHA-256 16e47ecd60ae5e46be9806254a48621a40d716b84f8c6f2de215b47584c9b8c0.

Reran the saved constrained routing-4 admin replay with an absent database path: exact saved result matched, via AMS retained, five routes, and no database was created. The snapshot digest matched f76f52e00886574f0a236fd5c95f3a640365beb4ffb95737253f88ad106e0955.

Reviewed retained current evidence: full 391-test suite, 93 browser checks, outside-checkout installed-wheel API probe, six synthetic benchmarks and 64 concurrent read-only HTTP requests. These were performed by other roles; this reviewer did not independently rerun their browser or HTTP harnesses.

findings_disposition.F01_input_validation: Resolved: malformed avoidance/import/replay input and UTC overflow have deliberate validation/error behavior; invalid imports precede database creation.
findings_disposition.F02_exact_airport_constraints: Accepted: required via applies before complete-route/tail ranking; immediate next destination applies before option counting/paging; transfer direction and actual endpoint use matter; chosen-next conflicts return stable 422; retained prefixes remain exact.
findings_disposition.F03_partial_and_replay_truth: Accepted: candidate/record exhaustion remains explicit, unknown codes give scoped empty results, feasible dead-end options remain incomplete, and routing-4 rejects incompatible routing-3 replay.
findings_disposition.F04_storage_and_admin: Accepted for local use: serving uses read-only/query-only connections and consistent snapshots; internal writes are transactional; reset is confirmed and restricted to the project var directory; demo selects a separate ignored database and binds loopback.
findings_disposition.F05_manifest_refresh: Resolved: the initial 4c66 freeze became stale after frontend/evidence/documentation repairs. This receipt accepts only the refreshed ebe1 manifest and its matching browser/package evidence; it does not certify superseded bytes.
findings_disposition.F06_remote_ci_claim: Resolved in the refreshed README: the remote run is now prospective and required before merge, consistent with checks.json. Actual current-head remote CI and merge acceptance remain pending.

limitations: This reviewer authored the earlier core validation and via/next implementation and its tests; this is disclosed engineering self-review plus independent evidence checks, not an independent human signature. The separate QA auditor supplies the independent release review.

Acceptance is limited to the exact local preview/demo and reviewable PR. Public hosting/access controls, production readiness, provider coverage/rights, movement deduplication, booking suitability and commercial transfer rules remain pending.
Customer sessions, measured demand, final layout choice, all research needs and accessibility conformance are not established by automated checks or this receipt.
Runtime evidence is local Python 3.14.7/macOS. Remote Python 3.11/3.13 and Chromium CI must pass for the actual PR head; no merge green light is given here.

Routing is bounded simple-airport schedule search over loaded snapshots. Completeness/ranking claims are confined to that scope; one exact via is supported, dead-end next options are retained, and mismatched next candidates still consume the search budget.

The 64-request HTTP probe had no active writer and is not capacity evidence. The SQLite test separately verifies a reader snapshot during a process writer commit. Synthetic transfer allowances do not certify a feasible commercial connection.
Any later substantive change to manifested source, tests, evidence or documentation requires affected review again.
